About Auto Opulence

Professional care, properly equipped.

Auto Opulence is a Norwich vehicle-care specialist built around careful methods, clear service choices and a purpose-equipped indoor facility.

Book a service Contact the team

What we do

One place for everyday care and specialist detailing.

Our service range covers the complete journey from routine vehicle cleaning to more involved paint correction and long-term ceramic protection. Each booking begins with the service required, the vehicle-size band and its present condition. This gives customers a clearer route to the right treatment and allows the working time to be planned properly.

Private customers can book washing, interior or exterior valeting, polishing and protection. Enthusiasts and automotive professionals can also hire the equipped valet bay for their own work. Businesses can use our commercial vehicle-care routes for fleets, dealerships, taxis, lease returns, garages and bodyshops.

Professional equipment

Built to support better work.

The indoor facility combines washing, interior cleaning and paint-refinement equipment in one controlled workspace.

Climate-controlled indoor bay

A sheltered working environment supports consistent cleaning, polishing and coating work throughout the year.

Wash floor and drainage

Purpose-planned drainage allows controlled indoor washing without relying on unsuitable outdoor spaces.

Paint-inspection lighting

A specialist lighting tunnel makes swirls, haze and polishing progress easier to assess accurately.

Kranzle K7 pressure washer

Professional pressure-washing equipment supports thorough pre-washing, rinsing and wheel cleaning.

Inline spotless water

Filtered water helps reduce mineral spotting and supports a cleaner final rinse during vehicle preparation.

Extraction and wet-vacuum equipment

Interior cleaning equipment supports carpets, mats, upholstery and detailed cabin work where appropriate.

Our approach

Care planned around the vehicle.

We do not treat every car as though it needs the same process. The safest useful result depends on how the vehicle is used, its materials, its existing protection and the condition of the paint or cabin.

Read our vehicle-care guides
  • Condition-led recommendationsWork is matched to what the vehicle genuinely needs.
  • Surface-appropriate productsPaint, trim, glass, fabrics and wheels receive suitable treatment.
  • Clear finishing checksCompleted work is reviewed before vehicle handover.
